```{r, warnings=FALSE, include = FALSE}
options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org/"))
#install.packages("readr")

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(haven)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)
```

```{r}
# Read full ANES panel data
library(tidyverse)

anes_panel_full <- read_csv(
  "ANES_Panel_Full.csv",
  na = c("", " ", "NA"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Select variables needed 
anes_selected <- anes_panel_full %>%
  select(

    # Respondent / Case IDs
    V160001_orig,   # Stable 2016 respondent ID
    V160001,        # 2016 case ID

    # Sample / interview completion status
    V160502,        # 2016 pre/post completion
    V200003,        # 2020 sample type
    V200004,        # 2020 pre/post completion
    V240003,        # 2024 sample type
    V240002c,       # 2024 pre/post completion
    
    # PRE Trump Feeling Thermometer
    V161087,        # 2016
    V201152,        # 2020
    V241157,        # 2024

    # POST Trump Feeling Thermometer
    V162079,        # 2016
    V202144,        # 2020
    V242126,        # 2024

    # PRE Party of Registration
    # Don't use POST here since so many NAs in 2024
    V161019,        # 2016
    V201018,        # 2020
    V241025,        # 2024

    # Race / Ethnicity
    V161310x,       # 2016
    V201549x,       # 2020
    V241501x,       # 2024

    # PRE Liberal-Conservative Self-Placement
    # Don't use POST here since we only have 2016 data
    V161126,        # 2016
    V201200,        # 2020
    V241177,        # 2024

    # Respondent Gender / Sex
    V161342,        # 2016
    V201600,        # 2020
    V241550,        # 2024

    # State
    V161010d,       # 2016 FIPS state
    V203000,        # 2020 FIPS state
    V243002,        # 2024 FIPS state

    # PRE / POST Weights
    V160101,        # 2016 PRE weight
    V160102,        # 2016 POST weight

    V200011a,       # 2020 panel PRE weight
    V200011b,       # 2020 panel POST weight

    V240106a,       # 2024 panel PRE weight
    V240106b,       # 2024 panel POST weight

    # PSU / Stratum
    V160201,        # 2016 Stratum – Full sample 
    V160202,        # 2016 Variance PSU – full sample 

    V200011c,       # 2020 panel variance unit
    V200011d,       # 2020 panel variance stratum

    V240106c,       # 2024 panel PSU
    V240106d,       # 2024 panel stratum
    
    # Additional 2024 Full-Sample PSU / Stratum
    V240108c,       # 2024 Full-sample PSU
    V240108d        # 2024 Full-sample Stratum
  ) %>%

    # Create 2024 Full-Sample Cluster ID
mutate(
  cluster_full_2024 = 1000 * (
    as.numeric(V240108c) + as.numeric(V240108d)
  )
)
```

### Mi - Descriptive plots for Political Ideology vs. Feel Thermometer
### Race vs. Feel Thermometer Plots
```{r}
# Descriptive plots for Political Ideology vs. Feel Thermometer 2016
ggplot(data = anes_selected %>% filter(V161126 %in% c(1:7)), aes(x = factor(V161126, labels = c("Extremely liberal", "Liberal", "Slightly liberal", "Moderate", "Slightly conservative", "Conservative", "Extremely conservative")), y = V162079)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Political Ideology", y = "Trump Feeling Thermometer", title = "2016 Political Ideology vs. Feeling Thermometer") +
  guides(x = guide_axis(n.dodge = 2))

# Descriptive plots for Political Ideology vs. Feel Thermometer 2020
ggplot(data = anes_selected %>% filter(V201200 %in% c(1:7)), aes(x = factor(V201200, labels = c("Extremely liberal", "Liberal", "Slightly liberal", "Moderate", "Slightly conservative", "Conservative", "Extremely conservative")), y = V202144)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Political Ideology", y = "Trump Feeling Thermometer", title = "2020 Political Ideology vs. Feeling Thermometer") +
  guides(x = guide_axis(n.dodge = 2))

# Descriptive plots for Political Ideology vs. Feel Thermometer 2024
ggplot(data = anes_selected %>% filter(V241177 %in% c(1:7)), aes(x = factor(V241177, labels = c("Extremely liberal", "Liberal", "Slightly liberal", "Moderate", "Slightly conservative", "Conservative", "Extremely conservative")), y = V242126)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Political Ideology", y = "Trump Feeling Thermometer", title = "2024 Political Ideology vs. Feeling Thermometer") +
  guides(x = guide_axis(n.dodge = 2))

# Descriptive plots for Race vs. Feel Thermometer 2016
ggplot(data = anes_selected %>% filter(V161310x %in% c(1:6)), aes(x = factor(V161310x, labels = c("White, non-Hispanic", "Black, non-Hispanic", "Hispanic", "Asian / Pacific Islander, non-Hispanic", "Native American / Alaska Native or other race", "Multiple races, non-Hispanic")), y = V162079)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Race", y = "Trump Feeling Thermometer", title = "2016 Race vs. Feeling Thermometer") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Descriptive plots for Race vs. Feel Thermometer 2020
ggplot(data = anes_selected %>% filter(V201549x %in% c(1:6)), aes(x = factor(V201549x, labels = c("White, non-Hispanic", "Black, non-Hispanic", "Hispanic", "Asian / Pacific Islander, non-Hispanic", "Native American / Alaska Native or other race", "Multiple races, non-Hispanic")), y = V202144)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Race", y = "Trump Feeling Thermometer", title = "2020 Race vs. Feeling Thermometer") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Descriptive plots for Race vs. Feel Thermometer 2024
ggplot(data = anes_selected %>% filter(V241501x %in% c(1:6)), aes(x = factor(V241501x, labels = c("White, non-Hispanic", "Black, non-Hispanic", "Hispanic", "Asian / Pacific Islander, non-Hispanic", "Native American / Alaska Native or other race", "Multiple races, non-Hispanic")), y = V242126)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Race", y = "Trump Feeling Thermometer", title = "2024 Race vs. Feeling Thermometer") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
